instruction.text: Read these directions to go to the cinema and drag them into the correct order.

elements: Firstly, wait on platform 2 at 'Lime Park' for your train.
Next, get off at the station 'Purple Street'.
When at 'Purple Street', walk around 300 metres until you arrive to the cinema.
Finally, buy some popcorn, find your seat and enjoy!

instruction.text: Read these instructions on how to make soup and drag them into the correct order.

elements: Firstly, heat olive oil and onions in a saucepan until soft.
Secondly, add 1 kg of squash to the pan and cook until golden.
After ten minutes, add vegetable stock and double cream into the pan and bring to a boil.
At the end, turn the heat off, add croutons and enjoy!

instruction.text: Read these instructions on how to test the boiling point of water and drag them into the correct order.

elements: Firstly, add 25ml of water to a boiling tube and insert a thermometer.
Next, attach the boiling tube to a stand and apply heat gently, rotating the flame.
Note at which temperature the water starts boiling.
Then, continue to boil the water until the temperature becomes constant.
